title: Direct prompt injection hijacks planning agent goals
summary: Attacker-supplied instructions override the agent's intended goals via a language-mediated control path.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The synthetic fixture uses a model to pursue a delegated goal and select or sequence actions that affect its environment.

LC.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI01-001: Attacker-supplied natural language reaches a privileged decision or tool-invocation path without mediation.

CP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI01-001: Attacker-controlled context persists only in ephemeral session state (conversation buffer, in-memory working context, session-scoped cache), and testing confirms it is unreachable after the session boundary.

AP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI01-001: Propagation occurs within the agent's own tool and action scope but does not cross a trust boundary.

SR.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI01-001: A production-equivalent fixture records 30 successful independent episodes out of 30, each from clean state with the hard production budget of three attempts for one stable principal; the one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound is 0.917.

EX.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI01-001: One or more vetted extensions are fixed and allowlisted, with schema-validated arguments and least-privilege credentials enforced outside model output.

PT.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI01-001: Synthetic provider ref-provider and deployment model-ref-v1 are fixed under config-ref-v1 and changes are auditable, but provider-side artifact contents cannot be verified at runtime.

CA.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI01-001: A finite hard request ceiling is enforced, but its aggregate coverage across a stable principal and tenant is incomplete.

TD.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI01-001: A retrieval test reconstructs ordered actions and principals but finds missing integrity or retention evidence.
